description:
You are an infectious disease specialist checking whether a patient's anti-tuberculosis medication is safe to continue alongside a new cancer treatment. 

1. Open the Liverpool Cancer iChart app.
2. Look up the cancer drug 'Sunitinib' (you may need to search or use the A-Z index).
3. Check the interaction with the co-medication 'Rifampicin' (an anti-TB drug).
4. Identify the traffic light color shown for this interaction (Red, Orange, Yellow, or Green).
5. Save ONLY the color name (in lowercase, e.g., 'green') to a text file at: /sdcard/Download/interaction_result.txt
